what: Drag the card row to flip through it — on press the cards squash to .95 spreading outward from the pressed card (.3s power1.inOut, spread .25s), while dragging the row follows 1.3× the hand movement with a .6s power3.out lag (skipping one beat every two frames, and at both ends only up to 1/10 of the window width), and on release a drag over 80px advances one card (.6s power3.out). With a mouse, a round cursor trails by .6s and on press the HOLD text turns into two arrows (.3s)

options.bound: Limit (px) at which the edges pull harder, default window width / 10
options.ease: Advance curve in the form ”0.16,1,0.3,1” or a GSAP name, default power3.out
options.[data-fx-part=slip]: Outer band that follows while dragging
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Inner paging strip (cards line up horizontally)
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Card — if it contains a link, it opens only on release, not on drag
options.[data-fx-part=cursor]: Following circle cursor (optional) — inside it [data-fx-part=label](HOLD)·[data-fx-part=arrows](arrows on press)
